name: Seat Probe (research)
description: Research for Koleda's FRV Sinner. Logs your seat whenever it changes, and the FRV gun's nodes 4 s after an FRV lands. F1: the nearest FRV's seats. Ctrl+F1: put you in a seat instantly (Alt+F1 picks the seat: 3 driver, 2 gunner). Shift+Insert: swing the next gun node left-right for 3 s (from node 18). Ctrl+Insert: swing the next one up-down (from node 19). Host or solo. Turn off when done.
